title: SAML replay protection and HSM quorum operational matrix
creator: Marina Chen
description: Problem: Private deployments rely on customer SAML identity providers. We have observed two classes of risk: (1) accidental or malicious replay of SAML assertions causing session fixation or unauthorized elevation; (2) operator key compromise during HSM-backed key rotation. Goal: define deterministic acceptance criteria, a phased rollout, and an operational matrix that ties SAML assertion hardening (validation checks + replay detection), RBAC templates for operator actions, and HSM quorum controls into a single sign-offable PRD. Out-of-scope: upstream IdP configuration beyond our recommended hardening guide (we will surface requirements but not change IdP settings).
acceptance_criteria: SAML assertion validation: system rejects assertions failing 'IssuedAt' nonce or duplicate AssertionID within configured TTL (default 5s) during both live and canary traffic
Replay detection: detection triggers an alert to security channel and increments a replay counter in audit logs; metric documented in console and dashboard panel exists
HSM rotation: rotation flow requires 2-of-3 operator approvals in private deploys by default; rotation attempt without quorum is rejected and logged
RBAC: operator role templates (rotator, auditor, emergency-operator) defined and shipped in the private deploy Terraform module with least-privilege policies
Failover: automated SSO failover to configured secondary IdP occurs within SLO when primary IdP rejects assertion with a valid retry window; can be disabled via org policy
Test matrix: end-to-end replay-injection test passes in staging and pilot with no customer-visible session leakage
Audit trail immutability: assertion replay events and operator approvals are retained in append-only audit storage for 1 year (configurable) and exportable as evidence.zip
decisions: Use assertionID dedupe + IssuedAt skew window (±5s default) rather than relying only on NotOnOrAfter because some IdPs have clock skew.
Implement replay detection as an idempotent middleware in front of session service to ensure consistent semantics across hosted/dedicated/private.
Default HSM quorum set to 2-of-3 operators; allow customers to configure to 3-of-5 via Private deployment config.
Expose RBAC templates as both Terraform module and console role templates to simplify operator onboarding.

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: aggressive assertion TTL could break poorly-configured IdPs. Mitigation: set sane defaults and provide rollback flag and per-customer tuning in operator console.
Risk: HSM quorum UX friction during emergency rotations. Mitigation: define emergency 'break-glass' flow with stricter logging and post-rotation review requirement.
Risk: false positives from replay detection flood alerts. Mitigation: tiered alerting + auto-throttle and exploratory metric dashboard for tuning.
